basic_details.job_title: Jamia Hamdard Assistant Professor (Jarahiyat) Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The walk-in interview for Assistant Professor at Jamia Hamdard is on Thursday, 26 November 2026, with reporting at 10.00 AM. content_sections.heading: Jamia Hamdard Assistant Professor Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the pay amount or the application fee.

rows.details: Board Room, Vice-Chancellor's Office, First Floor, Administrative Building, Jamia Hamdard Campus, New Delhi- 110062
Assistant Professor (Post Code 001), subject/discipline Ilmul Jarahat, contractual basis
Remuneration/Salary as per Jamia Hamdard norms
Candidates fulfilling the qualifications and experience given in the notice

content_sections.heading: About Jamia Hamdard
content_sections.text: Jamia Hamdard is a Deemed to be University at Hamdard Nagar, New Delhi- 110062, which describes itself on its letterhead as accredited by NAAC in 'A+' Category. This post sits in the Department of Jarahiyat of its School of Unani Medical Education and Research (SUMER).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One (01) Assistant Professor post for Ilmul Jarahat, Post Code 001, is open on contractual basis. The qualification must be from a UGC recognized University/Institution only. A Bachelor degree in Unani Medicine from a University or its equivalent as recognized by the Central Council of Indian Medicine or National Commission for Indian System of Medicine under the Act; and A Post-graduate qualification in Unani in the concerned subject or specialty from a university recognised by the Central Council of Indian Medicine or National Commission for Indian System of Medicine under the Act; A valid registration with the concerned State Board or Council where he/she is employed, or a valid Central or National Registration Certificate issued by the Central Council of Indian Medicine or National Commission for Indian System of Medicine. Have qualified National Teachers Eligibility Test (NTET). NTET is not applicable to those who have NCISM's Teacher Code (Ref. No. Sec/Commission/2023-1/Misc. Dated: 14.12.2023), subject to the implementation of NTET by NCISM and related notifications from time to time. Such candidates are required to submit details only in the prescribed application format along with a copy of their updated CV. Age shall not exceed forty-five years at the time of first appointment. The notice prints no age relaxation. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility details of the post.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates fulfilling the qualifications and experience may come for the walk-in interview at the venue above with the following: Details as per the enclosed application format (the format is on page 2 of the notice and asks for personal details, educational qualifications, NET/GATE status, employment records and a declaration, with a recent colour photograph pasted) Detailed CV Original educational and experience certificates Testimonials One set of attested copies of these for verification

content_sections.heading: What Happens on the Day
content_sections.text: Reporting time is 10.00 AM. A candidate will not be allowed in any circumstances if reported after 11.00 AM. Candidates found not fulfilling the eligibility and experience criteria will not be allowed to appear before the interview.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA shall be payable for attending the interview. The post is on contractual basis; remuneration/salary is as per Jamia Hamdard norms. The application format declares that if any material information is found concealed or distorted, the appointment is liable to be summarily terminated without notice or compensation.

faq.question: Q1. When is the Jamia Hamdard Assistant Professor walk-in interview?
faq.answer: It is on Thursday, 26 November 2026. Reporting time is 10.00 AM, and candidates reporting after 11.00 AM will not be allowed in any circumstances.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: The venue is the Board Room, Vice-Chancellor's Office, First Floor, Administrative Building, Jamia Hamdard Campus, New Delhi- 110062.

faq.question: Q3. How many Assistant Professor posts are there?
faq.answer: There is one (01) post of Assistant Professor in Ilmul Jarahat on contractual basis, in the Department of Jarahiyat, School of Unani Medical Education and Research (SUMER).

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification for the Assistant Professor post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor degree in Unani Medicine and a post-graduate qualification in Unani in the concerned subject or specialty, both recognised by CCIM or NCISM, plus valid registration and a qualified National Teachers Eligibility Test (NTET) unless the candidate holds an NCISM Teacher Code.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Age shall not exceed forty-five years at the time of first appointment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this post?
faq.answer: The notice states Remuneration/Salary as per Jamia Hamdard norms and prints no amount.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I bring?
faq.answer: Bring details as per the enclosed application format, a detailed CV, original educational and experience certificates, testimonials and one set of attested copies for verification.

faq.question: Q8. Is TA/DA paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice says no TA/DA shall be payable for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is NTET compulsory for all candidates?
faq.answer: No. NTET is not applicable to those who have NCISM's Teacher Code (Ref. No. Sec/Commission/2023-1/Misc. Dated: 14.12.2023), subject to the implementation of NTET by NCISM and related notifications from time to time.

faq.question: Q10. Is this a permanent post?
faq.answer: No. The notice invites applications for engagement on contractual basis.
